svg.title: SD07 — Talk to NPC and Accept Quest (UC03, UC07; F03, F07)

g.text: SD07 — Talk to NPC and Accept Quest (UC03, UC07; F03, F07)
SD02 / SD03 — "talk to the blacksmith": TalkCommand.execute()
sets the mode to new DialogueMode(blacksmith)
type "Do you have any work for me?"
(prompt: NPC profile and knowledge + memory context, focus = the NPC;
isValid: no secret revealed, side effect well-formed;
fallback: pre-written line for the NPC's role)
SD03 — an invalid side effect (e.g. a TAKE of
an item that is not in the location) is rejected
SD05 — recorded in the event log
SD00 — Run an LLM Task (LLM returns a QuestProposal as JSON)
location, item and NPC exists; retry once, then fallback:
template quest. toQuest() clamps the reward to the level maximum.
the quest is discarded; the NPC can make
a new offer only in a later conversation
